chinese: 我住在华盛顿街1203号。

chinese: 我是史密斯先生的隔壁邻居。

english: You live here in the city, dont you?
chinese: 你住在这个城市，对吧？

chinese: 我来自外地。

english: How long have you lived here?
chinese: 你在这里住多久了？

chinese: 我在这里住了五年。

chinese: 他认识我超过十年了。

chinese: 我一生都在说英语。

english: Ive already read that book.
chinese: 我已经读过那本书了。

english: Has he studied French very long?
chinese: 他学法语很久了吗？

english: Have you had breakfast already?
chinese: 你已经吃过早饭了吗？

chinese: 是的，我两小时前吃了早饭。

english: Where were you yesterday afternoon?
chinese: 昨天下午你在哪里？

chinese: 我整个下午都在家。

chinese: 我在给朋友们写信。

chinese: 昨天下午4点左右你在做什么？

chinese: 我在听收音机。

chinese: 我打电话给你时，你在做什么？

chinese: 你打电话给我时，我正在吃晚饭。

english: When I saw Mr. Jones, he was talking with John Smith.
chinese: 我看到琼斯先生时，他正在和约翰·史密斯交谈。

chinese: 你写信的时候，我在看书。

chinese: 我们吃早饭时，约翰在打电话。

english: What color is your book?
chinese: 你的书是什么颜色？

chinese: 我的书是深蓝色封面。

english: How much does that typewriter weigh?
chinese: 那台打字机有多重？

chinese: 这张圆桌大约重45磅。

english: What size suitcase do you own?
chinese: 你有多大的行李箱？

english: One of my suitcases is small, and the other one is medium size.
chinese: 我的一个行李箱小，另一个是中号。

english: I like the shape of that table.
chinese: 我喜欢那张桌子的形状。

english: How long is Jones Boulevard?
chinese: 琼斯大道有多长？

english: That street is only two miles long.
chinese: 那条街只有两英里长。

english: Will you please measure this window to see how wide it is?
chinese: 请量一下这扇窗户有多宽好吗？

english: This window is just as wide as that one.
chinese: 这扇窗户和那扇一样宽。

english: The walls are three inches thick.
chinese: 墙有三英寸厚。

english: This material feels soft.
chinese: 这料子摸起来很软。

english: This pencil is longer than that one.
chinese: 这支铅笔比那支长。

english: Would you please tell Mr. Cooper that Im here?
chinese: 请告诉库珀先生我到了好吗？

english: Take these books home with you tonight.
chinese: 今晚把这些书带回家。

english: Please bring me those magazines
chinese: 请把那些杂志拿给我。

english: Would you help me lift this heavy box?
chinese: 帮我抬一下这个重箱子好吗？

english: Please ask John to turn on the lights.
chinese: 请让约翰开灯。

english: Put your books down on the table.
chinese: 把你的书放在桌上。

english: Get me a hammer from the kitchen, will you?
chinese: 从厨房给我拿把锤子来好吗？

english: Hang up my coat in the closet, will you please?
chinese: 请把我的外套挂到衣柜里好吗？

english: Please dont bother me now. Im very busy.
chinese: 现在请别打扰我，我很忙。

english: Would you mind mailing this letter for me?
chinese: 你介意帮我寄这封信吗？

chinese: 如果有时间，明天能给我打电话吗？

english: Please pick up those cups and saucers.
chinese: 请把那些杯子和碟子收起来。

english: Will you do me a favor?
chinese: 能帮我个忙吗？

chinese: 请数一下那个房间里的椅子。

chinese: 请把牛奶倒进那个杯子里。

chinese: 打扰一下，先生。能给我一些信息吗？

chinese: 能告诉我桃树街在哪里吗？

english: Its two blocks straight ahead.
chinese: 一直往前走，过两个街区。

english: which direction is it to the theatre?
chinese: 去剧院往哪个方向走？

english: Turn right at the next corner?
chinese: 在下一个路口右转吗？

english: How far is it to the university?
chinese: 到大学有多远？

english: Its a long way from here.
chinese: 离这里很远。

english: The school is just around the corner.
chinese: 学校就在拐角处。

english: The restaurant is across the street from the hotel.
chinese: 餐厅在酒店街对面。

english: You cant miss it.
chinese: 你不会错过的。

english: Do you happen to know Mr. Coopers telephone number?
chinese: 你碰巧知道库珀先生的电话号码吗？

english: Could you tell me where the nearest telephone is?
chinese: 能告诉我最近的电话在哪里吗？

english: Should I go this way, or that way?
chinese: 我该走这边还是那边？

english: Go that way for two blocks, then turn left.
chinese: 往那边走两个街区，然后左转。

english: I beg your pardon. Is this seat taken?
chinese: 对不起，这个座位有人吗？

english: Are you married?
chinese: 你结婚了吗？

english: No, Im not married. Im still single.
chinese: 不，我没结婚。我还是单身。

english: Your niece is engaged, isnt she?
chinese: 你侄女订婚了，对吧？

english: My sister has been engaged for two months.
chinese: 我姐姐已经订婚两个月了。

english: My grandfather got married in 1921.
chinese: 我祖父1921年结婚。

english: When is grandparents wedding anniversary?
chinese: 祖父母的结婚纪念日是什么时候？

english: How long have they been married?
chinese: 他们结婚多久了？

english: Theyve been married for quite a few years.
chinese: 他们已经结婚好几年了。

english: who did George marry?
chinese: 乔治和谁结婚了？

english: Do they have children?
chinese: 他们有孩子吗？

english: They had a baby last month.
chinese: 他们上个月生了个孩子。

english: My son wants to get married in June.
chinese: 我儿子想六月结婚。

english: They dont know when the wedding will be.
chinese: 他们不知道婚礼什么时候举行。

english: Their grandchildren are grown up now. 4
chinese: 他们的孙辈现在都长大了。

english: Shes a widow. Her husband died last year.
chinese: 她是个寡妇。她丈夫去年去世了。

english: Where did you grow up?
chinese: 你在哪里长大？

english: I grew up right here in this neighborhood.
chinese: 我就在这个街区长大的。

english: My friend spent his childhood in California.
chinese: 我朋友在加利福尼亚度过了童年。

english: He lived in California until he was seventeen.
chinese: 他在加利福尼亚住到十七岁。

english: There have been a lot of changes here in the last 20 years.
chinese: 过去20年这里发生了很多变化。

english: There used to be a grocery store on the corner.
chinese: 拐角处曾经有一家杂货店。

english: All of those houses have been built in the last ten years.
chinese: 所有这些房子都是过去十年内建成的。

english: Theyre building a new house up the street from me.
chinese: 他们正在我家沿街那头建一栋新房子。

english: If you buy that home, will you spend the rest of your life there?
chinese: 如果你买了那栋房子，你会在那里度过余生吗？

english: Are your neighbors very friendly?
chinese: 你的邻居们很友好吗？

english: We all know each other pretty well.
chinese: 我们彼此都很熟悉。

english: A young married couple moved in next door to us.
chinese: 一对年轻夫妇搬到了我们隔壁。

english: Who bought that new house down the street from you?
chinese: 谁买了你沿街那头的那栋新房子？

english: An elderly man rented the big white house.
chinese: 一位老人租下了那栋白色大房子。

english: What beautiful trees those are!
chinese: 那些树真美啊！

english: What time are you going to get up tomorrow morning?
chinese: 你明天早上几点起床？

english: Ill probably wake up early and get up at 6:30.
chinese: 我可能会早醒，六点半起床。

english: What will you do then?
chinese: 那你接下来做什么？

english: After I get dressed, Ill have breakfast.
chinese: 穿好衣服后，我吃早餐。

english: What will you have for breakfast tomorrow morning?
chinese: 你明天早餐吃什么？

english: Ill probably have eggs and toast for breakfast.
chinese: 我早餐可能吃鸡蛋和吐司。

english: After breakfast, Ill get ready ro go to work.
chinese: 早餐后，我准备去上班。

english: Ill leave the house at 8:00 and get to the office at 8:30.
chinese: 我八点出门，八点半到办公室。

english: Ill probably go out for lunch at about 12:30.
chinese: 我大概十二点半出去吃午饭。

english: Ill finish working at 5:30 and get home by 6 oclock.
chinese: 我五点半下班，六点到家。

english: Are you going to have dinner at home tomorrow night?
chinese: 你明晚在家吃饭吗？

english: Do you think youll go to the movies tomorrow night?
chinese: 你觉得你明晚会去看电影吗？

english: Ill probably stay home and watch television.
chinese: 我可能会待在家看电视。

english: When I get sleepy, Ill probably get ready for bed.
chinese: 困了的话，我可能就准备睡觉了。

english: Do you think youll be able to go to sleep right away?
chinese: 你觉得你能马上睡着吗？

english: How is the weather today?
chinese: 今天天气怎么样？

english: The weather is nice today.
chinese: 今天天气不错。

english: What was the weather like yesterday?
chinese: 昨天天气怎么样？

english: Y esterday it rained all day.
chinese: 昨天下了一整天雨。

english: What will the weather be like tomorrow?
chinese: 明天天气怎么样？

english: Its going to snow tomorrow.
chinese: 明天要下雪。

english: Its quite cold today.
chinese: 今天挺冷的。

english: Its been cloudy all morning.
chinese: 一上午都是阴天。

english: Is it raining now?
chinese: 现在在下雨吗？

english: Itll probably clear up this afternoon.
chinese: 今天下午可能会放晴。

english: The days are getting hotter.
chinese: 天越来越热了。

english: Today is the first day of spring.
chinese: 今天是春天的第一天。

english: Whats the temperature today?
chinese: 今天气温多少？

english: Its about seventy degrees Fahrenheit this afternoon.
chinese: 今天下午大约华氏七十度。

english: Theres a cool breeze this evening.
chinese: 今晚有凉风。

english: How are you feeling today?
chinese: 你今天感觉怎么样？

english: I dont feel very well this morning.
chinese: 今天早上我感觉不太舒服。

english: I was sick yesterday, but Im better today.
chinese: 我昨天病了，但今天好多了。

chinese: 我的烧退了，但还是咳嗽。410.我哥哥头痛得厉害。

english: My brother has a bad headache.
chinese: 我哥哥头痛得厉害。

english: Which of your arms is sore?
chinese: 你哪只手臂酸痛？

english: My right arm hurts. It hurts right here.
chinese: 我的右臂疼。就这儿疼。

english: Whats matter with you?
chinese: 你怎么了？

english: Ive got a pain in my back.
chinese: 我背疼。

english: Which foot hurts? Is it the left one?
chinese: 哪只脚疼？是左脚吗？

english: How did you break your leg?
chinese: 你的腿怎么断的？

english: I slipped on the stairs and fell down. I broke my leg.
chinese: 我在楼梯上滑倒摔了下来，腿断了。

english: Your right hand is swollen. Does it hurt?
chinese: 你的右手肿了。疼吗？

chinese: 在流血。你最好去看医生处理一下伤口。

english: I hope youll be well soon.
chinese: 希望你早日康复。

english: I get out of bed about 7 oclock every morning.
chinese: 我每天早上大约7点起床。

english: After getting up, I go into the bathroom and take a shower.
chinese: 起床后，我去浴室洗个澡。

english: Then, I shave, brush my teeth and comb my hair.
chinese: 然后，我刮胡子、刷牙、梳头。

english: After brushing my teeth, I put on my clothes.
chinese: 刷完牙后，我穿上衣服。

english: After that, I go downstairs to the kitchen to have breakfast.
chinese: 之后，我下楼去厨房吃早餐。

english: After eating breakfast, I go back upstairs again.
chinese: 吃完早餐后，我又回到楼上。

english: Then, its usually time to wake up my little brother.
chinese: 然后，通常该叫醒弟弟了。

chinese: 他还太小，不会自己穿衣服。

english: I wash his face and hands, and then I dress him.
chinese: 我给他洗脸洗手，然后帮他穿衣服。

english: He tries to button his own shirt, but he cant do it.
chinese: 他试着自己扣衬衫扣子，但扣不上。

english: My little brother takes a bath before he goes to bed at night.
chinese: 弟弟晚上睡觉前会洗澡。

english: He always forgets to wash behind his ears.
chinese: 他总是忘记洗耳后。

english: Im always tired when I come home from work.
chinese: 下班回家时我总是很累。

english: At bedtime, I take off my clothes and put on my pajamas.
chinese: 睡觉时，我脱下衣服换上睡衣。

english: I get into bed at about 11:30 and go right off to sleep.
chinese: 我大约11点半上床，很快就睡着了。

chinese: 他无法决定做什么。

chinese: 我哥哥去了墨西哥旅行。

english: It was a six-hour flight.
chinese: 飞行了六个小时。

english: How many passengers were on the train?
chinese: 火车上有多少乘客？

english: His friend was injured in an airplane crash.
chinese: 他的朋友在飞机失事中受伤了。

english: Would you like to go for a walk?
chinese: 你想去散步吗？

english: Lets go out to the airport. The plane landed ten minutes ago.
chinese: 我们去机场吧，飞机十分钟前降落了。

english: Im going shopping because I need to buy some clothes.
chinese: 我去购物，因为需要买些衣服。

english: If this shirt doesnt fit, may I bring it back later?
chinese: 如果这件衬衫不合身，我可以稍后退货吗？

english: What size shoes do you wear?
chinese: 你穿多大码的鞋？

english: That suit looks very good on you.
chinese: 那套西装你穿很好看。

english: This dress is made of silk, isnt it?
chinese: 这条裙子是丝绸做的，对吧？

english: Id like to try on this sweater.
chinese: 我想试穿这件毛衣。

english: Im interested in buying a new car.
chinese: 我有兴趣买辆新车。

english: Whats the price of that electric iron?
chinese: 那个电熨斗多少钱？

english: How much is this rug?
chinese: 这块地毯多少钱？

english: Is this toothpaste on sale today?
chinese: 这支牙膏今天特价吗？

english: Thats a beautiful leather wallet, but it costs too much.
chinese: 那是个漂亮的皮钱包，但太贵了。

english: How much do I owe you?
chinese: 我该付你多少钱？

english: That will be eighteen dollars and seventy-five cents.
chinese: 一共十八美元七十五美分。

english: Do you have change for a twenty-dollar bill?
chinese: 你能换开二十美元的钞票吗？

english: The clerk helped me find what I wanted.
chinese: 店员帮我找到了我想要的东西。

english: What would you like to eat?
chinese: 你想吃什么？

english: Id like a bowl of tomato soup, please.
chinese: 请给我来一碗番茄汤。

english: The waiter seems to be in a hurry to take our order.
chinese: 服务员似乎急着让我们点菜。

english: Which would you rather have--steak or fish?
chinese: 你更想要哪个——牛排还是鱼？

english: I want my steak well-done.
chinese: 我的牛排要全熟的。

english: What kinds of vegetables do you have?
chinese: 你们有什么蔬菜？

english: Ill have mashed potatoes and green beans.
chinese: 我要土豆泥和青豆。

english: Would you please pass the salt?
chinese: 请把盐递给我好吗？

english: They serve good food in this restaurant.
chinese: 这家餐厅的食物不错。

english: Are you ready for your dessert now?
chinese: 你准备好吃甜点了吗？

english: This knife is dirty. Would you bring me a clean one, please?
chinese: 这把刀是脏的。请给我拿一把干净的，好吗？

english: May I have the check, please?
chinese: 请给我账单，好吗？

english: You have your choice of three flavors of ice cream.
chinese: 你可以从三种口味的冰淇淋中选。

english: We have vanilla, chocolate, and strawberry.
chinese: 我们有香草、巧克力和草莓。

english: We invited two guests to dinner, but they didnt come.
chinese: 我们邀请了两位客人来吃晚饭，但他们没来。

english: How long did the movie last?
chinese: 电影放了多久？

english: The feature started at 9 oclock and ended at 11:30.
chinese: 正片9点开始，11点半结束。

english: They say the new film is an adventure story.
chinese: 他们说这部新片是冒险故事。

english: A group of us went out to the theater last night.
chinese: 昨晚我们一群人去了剧院。

english: The new play was good and everybody enjoyed it.
chinese: 新剧不错，大家都很喜欢。

english: By the time we got there, the play had already begun.
chinese: 我们到那儿时，剧已经开演了。

english: The usher showed us to our seats.
chinese: 引座员带我们到座位。

english: The cast of the play included a famous actor.
chinese: 剧的演员阵容包括一位著名演员。

english: After the play was over, we all wanted to get something to eat.
chinese: 剧结束后，我们都想吃点东西。

english: There was a big crowd and we had difficulty getting a taxi.
chinese: 人很多，我们很难打到出租车。

english: The restaurant was filled, so we decided to go elsewhere.
chinese: 餐厅满了，所以我们决定去别处。

english: My brother wants to learn how to dance.
chinese: 我弟弟想学跳舞。

english: We dont go dancing very often.
chinese: 我们不常去跳舞。

english: Which would you rather do--go dancing or go to a play?
chinese: 你更愿意做什么——去跳舞还是去看剧？

english: Im not accustomed to going out after dark.
chinese: 我不习惯天黑后出门。

english: Id like to make an appointment to see Mr. Cooper.
chinese: 我想预约见库珀先生。

english: Would you like to arrange for a personal interview?
chinese: 你想安排一次面谈吗？

english: Your appointment will be next Thursday at 10 oclock.
chinese: 你的预约是下周四10点。

english: I can come any day except Thursday. 6
chinese: 除了周四，我哪天都能来。

english: He wants to change his appointment from Monday to Wednesday.
chinese: 他想把预约从周一改到周三。

english: She failed to call the office to cancel her appointment.
chinese: 她忘了打电话到办公室取消预约。

english: Im going to call the employment agency for a job.
chinese: 我要打电话给职业介绍所找工作。

english: Please fill in this application form.
chinese: 请填写这份申请表。

english: Are you looking for a permanent position?
chinese: 你在找长期职位吗？

english: Im going to call a plumber to come this afternoon.
chinese: 我要打电话叫水管工今天下午来。

english: I couldnt keep the appointment because I was sick.
chinese: 我因为生病没能赴约。

english: Im a new employee. I was hired yesterday.
chinese: 我是新员工，昨天刚被录用。

english: Please call before you come, otherwise we might not be home.
chinese: 来之前请先打电话，否则我们可能不在家。

english: Lets make a date to go shopping next Thursday.
chinese: 我们约下周四去购物吧。

english: Will you please lock the door when you leave?
chinese: 你离开时请锁门好吗？

english: I went to see my doctor for a check-up yesterday.
chinese: 我昨天去看医生做体检。

english: The doctor discovered that Im a little overweight.
chinese: 医生发现我有点超重。

english: He gave me a chest X-ray and took my blood pressure.
chinese: 他给我做了胸部X光检查，还量了血压。

english: He told me to take these pills every four hours.
chinese: 他让我每四小时服一次这些药。

english: Do you think the patient can be cured?
chinese: 你觉得这个病人能治好吗？

english: They operated on him last night.
chinese: 他们昨晚给他做了手术。

english: He needed a blood transfusion.
chinese: 他需要输血。

english: My uncle had a heart attack last year.
chinese: 我叔叔去年心脏病发作。

english: They had to call in a heart specialist.
chinese: 他们不得不请来一位心脏病专家。

english: What did the doctor say?
chinese: 医生怎么说？

english: The doctor advised me to get plenty of exercise.
chinese: 医生建议我多锻炼。

english: The doctor said I look pale.
chinese: 医生说我看起来苍白。

english: If I want to be healthy, I have to stop smoking cigarettes.
chinese: 如果想健康，我必须戒烟。

english: The physician said smoking is harmful to my health.
chinese: 医生说吸烟有害健康。

english: Its just a mosquito bite. Theres nothing to worry about.
chinese: 只是蚊子咬的，没什么好担心的。

english: Y oure wanted on the telephone.
chinese: 有人打电话找你。

english: What number should I dial to get the operator?
chinese: 打什么号码找接线员？

english: I want to make a long distance call.
chinese: 我想打长途电话。

english: Pick up the receiver and deposit a coin in the slot.
chinese: 拿起听筒，往投币口投一枚硬币。

english: I tried to call Mr. Cooper, but the line was busy.
chinese: 我试着打给库珀先生，但占线。

english: You must have dialed the wrong number.
chinese: 你一定是拨错号码了。

english: I dialed the right number, but nobody answered.
chinese: 我拨对了号码，但没人接。

english: The telephone is ringing, would you answer it, please?
chinese: 电话响了，请接一下好吗？

english: Would you like to leave a message?
chinese: 你想留言吗？

english: Who is this? I dont recognize your voice.
chinese: 你是谁？我听不出你的声音。

english: Would you please tell Mr. Cooper I called?
chinese: 请告诉库珀先生我打过电话好吗？

english: Is this Empire 5-4093?
chinese: 这是Empire 5-4093吗？

english: I have to hang up now.
chinese: 我现在得挂电话了。

english: Put the receiver closer to your mouth. I cant hear you.
chinese: 把听筒靠近嘴边，我听不见你说话。

english: Would you mind calling back sometime tomorrow?
chinese: 你介意明天找个时间回电话吗？

english: How long has it been since youve heard from your uncle?
chinese: 你多久没收到你叔叔的信了？

english: A strange thing happened to me this morning.
chinese: 今天早上我遇到了一件怪事。

english: I was crossing the street and was almost hit by a car.
chinese: 我过马路时差点被车撞了。

english: Fortunately, I jumped back in time to avoid being hit.
chinese: 幸好我及时跳开，没被撞到。

english: It was a terrible experience, and I wont forget it.
chinese: 那是一次可怕的经历，我不会忘记。

english: Yesterday was such a beautiful day we decided to go for a drive.
chinese: 昨天天气很好，我们决定开车出去兜风。

english: We prepared a picnic lunch and drove down by the river.
chinese: 我们准备了野餐午餐，开车到河边。

english: After a while, we found a shady place under some poplar trees.
chinese: 过了一会儿，我们在杨树下找到了一个阴凉处。

english: On the way back home, we had a flat tire.
chinese: 回家的路上，我们的车胎瘪了。

english: It was after dark when we got back, and we were all tired.
chinese: 我们回来时天已经黑了，大家都累了。

english: I wish you would gi ve me a more detailed description of your trip.
chinese: 我希望你能更详细地描述一下你的旅行。

english: Speaking of trips, did I ever tell you about the experience I had?
chinese: 说到旅行，我有没有告诉过你我的经历？

english: We used to have a lot of fun when we were that age.
chinese: 我们在那个年纪时总是玩得很开心。

english: I cant recall the exact circumstances.
chinese: 我记不清具体的情况了。

english: I never realized that someday I would be living in New York.
chinese: 我从没想过有一天我会住在纽约。

english: We never imagined that John would become a doctor.
chinese: 我们从没想过约翰会成为医生。

english: Were looking for a house to rent for the summer.
chinese: 我们正在找一栋夏天租的房子。

english: Are you trying to find a furnished house?
chinese: 你在找带家具的房子吗？

english: This split-level house is for rent. Its a bargain.
chinese: 这栋错层式房子出租，很划算。

english: That house is for sale. It has central heating.
chinese: 那栋房子出售，有中央供暖。

english: We have a few kitchen things and a dining room set.
chinese: 我们有一些厨房用具和一套餐厅家具。

english: This is an interesting floor plan. Please show me the basement.
chinese: 这个平面图很有趣，请带我看看地下室。

english: The roof has leaks in it, and the front steps need to be fixed.
chinese: 屋顶有漏水，前门台阶也需要修。

english: Weve got to get a bed and a dresser for the bedroom.
chinese: 我们得给卧室买张床和梳妆台。

english: Does the back door have a lock on it?
chinese: 后门有锁吗？

english: Theyve already turned on the electricity. The house is ready.
chinese: 他们已经通了电，房子可以住了。

english: Im worried about the appearance of the floor.
chinese: 我担心地板的外观。

english: If you want a towel, look in the linen closet.
chinese: 如果你想找毛巾，看看亚麻布柜。

english: What style furniture do you have? Is it traditional?
chinese: 你有什么风格的家具？是传统风格吗？

english: We have drapes for the living room , but we need kitchen curtains.
chinese: 我们有客厅的窗帘，但需要厨房窗帘。

english: The house needs painting. Its in bad condition.
chinese: 房子需要粉刷。状况很差。

english: What do you going to wear today?
chinese: 你今天打算穿什么？

english: Im going to wear my blue suit. Is that all right?
chinese: 我打算穿我的蓝色西装。可以吗？

english: I have two suits to send to the cleaners.
chinese: 我有两套西装要送到干洗店。

english: I have some shirts to send to the laundry. 7
chinese: 我有一些衬衫要送到洗衣店。

english: You ought to have that coat cleaned and pressed.
chinese: 你应该把那件外套送去干洗和熨烫。

english: Ive got to get this shirt washed and ironed.
chinese: 我得把这件衬衫洗了并熨烫。

english: All my suits are dirty. I dont have anything to wear.
chinese: 我所有的西装都脏了。我没衣服穿了。

english: Youd better wear a light jacket. Its chilly today.
chinese: 你最好穿一件轻便夹克。今天很冷。

english: This dress doesnt fit me anymore.
chinese: 这件连衣裙不再合身了。

english: I guess Ive outgrown this pair of trousers.
chinese: 我想我穿不下这条裤子了。

english: These shoes are worn-out. Theyve lasted a long time.
chinese: 这双鞋已经磨损了。它们已经穿了很久。

english: I cant fasten this collar button.
chinese: 我系不上这个领扣。

english: Why dont you get dressed now? Put on your work clothes.
chinese: 你为什么不现在穿好衣服？穿上你的工作服。

english: My brother came in, changed his clothes, and went out again.
chinese: 我哥哥进来，换了衣服，又出去了。

english: I didnt notice you were wearing your new hat.
chinese: 我没注意到你戴着你的新帽子。

english: Y ou have your point of view, and I have mine.
chinese: 你有你的观点，我有我的。

english: Y ou approach it in a different way than I do.
chinese: 你处理的方式和我不同。

english: I wont argue with you, but I think youre being unfair.
chinese: 我不想和你争，但我觉得你不公平。

english: Thats a liberal point of view.
chinese: 那是开明的观点。

english: He seems to have a lot of strange ideas.
chinese: 他似乎有很多奇怪的想法。

english: I dont see any point in discussing the question any further.
chinese: 我觉得没必要再讨论这个问题了。

english: What alternatives do I have?
chinese: 我有什么选择？

english: Everyone is entitled to his own opinion.
chinese: 人人都有权持有自己的观点。

english: There are always two sides to everything.
chinese: 凡事都有两面。

english: We have opposite views on this.
chinese: 我们对此看法相反。

english: Please forgive me. I didnt mean to start an argument.
chinese: 请原谅我，我不是有意挑起争论的。

english: I must know your opinion. Do you agree with me?
chinese: 我必须知道你的看法。你同意我吗？

english: What point are you trying to make?
chinese: 你想说明什么？

english: Our views are not so far apart, after all.
chinese: 我们的观点毕竟没那么大分歧。

english: We should be able to resolve our differences.
chinese: 我们应该能解决分歧。

english: If it doesnt rain tomorrow, I think Ill go shopping.
chinese: 如果明天不下雨，我想去购物。

english: Theres a possibility well go, but it all depends on the weather.
chinese: 我们可能会去，但要看天气。

english: If I have time tomorrow, I think Ill get a haircut.
chinese: 如果明天有时间，我想去理发。

english: I hope I remember to ask the barber not to cut my hair too short.
chinese: 我希望记得让理发师别剪太短。

english: My son wants to be a policeman when he grows up.
chinese: 我儿子长大后想当警察。

english: If I get my work finished in time , Ill leave for New York Monday.
chinese: 如果我按时完成工作，周一就去纽约。

english: Suppose you couldnt go on the trip. How would you feel?
chinese: 假设你不能去旅行，你会怎么想？

english: What would you say if I told you I couldnt go with you?
chinese: 如果我告诉你我不能跟你去，你会怎么说？

english: If I buy the car, Ill have to borrow some money.
chinese: 如果我买这辆车，就得借些钱。

english: If I went with you, Id have to be back by six oclock.
chinese: 如果我跟你去，六点前得回来。

english: One of these days, Id like to take a vacation.
chinese: 哪天我想休个假。

english: As soon as I can, Im going to change jobs.
chinese: 我一有机会就换工作。

english: Theres a chance he wont be able to be home for Christmas.
chinese: 他有可能无法回家过圣诞节。

english: We may be able to help you in some way.
chinese: 我们也许能在某方面帮到你。

english: If you were to attend the banquet, what would you wear?
chinese: 如果你去参加宴会，你会穿什么？

english: What would you have done last night if you hadnt had to study?
chinese: 如果昨晚你不需要学习，你会做什么？

english: I would have gone on the picnic if it hadnt rained.
chinese: 如果没下雨，我就去野餐了。

english: If you had gotten up earlier , you would have had time for breakfast.
chinese: 如果你早点起床，就有时间吃早餐了。

english: If I had had time, I would have called you.
chinese: 如果我有时间，就给你打电话了。

english: Would he have seen you if you hadnt waved to him? If he had only had enough money, he would have bought that house. I wish you had called me back the next day, as I had asked you to.
chinese: 如果你没向他挥手，他会看到你吗？如果他钱够，就买那栋房子了。我希望你第二天能像我要你做的那样给我回电话。

english: If I had known that you were coming, I would have met you at the airport.
chinese: 如果我知道你要来，就去机场接你了。

english: If he had tried to leave the country, he would have been stopped at the border.
chinese: 如果他试图离开这个国家，会在边境被拦住。

english: If you hadn t slipped an d fallen , you wouldn t have broken your leg.
chinese: 如果你没滑倒，就不会摔断腿。

english: If you had told me earlier, I could have helped you.
chinese: 如果你早点告诉我，我就能帮你了。

english: If he had known the truth, he would have been very angry.
chinese: 如果他知道真相，会非常生气。

english: If she had worked harder, she would have succeeded.
chinese: 如果她更努力，她就会成功。

english: If they had left earlier, they would have caught the train.
chinese: 如果他们早点出发，就能赶上火车。

english: If I had seen him, I would have spoken to him.
chinese: 如果我见到他，我会跟他说话。

english: If we had known about the party, we would have come.
chinese: 如果我们知道派对的事，我们会来的。

english: If you had asked me, I would have told you.
chinese: 如果你问我，我会告诉你的。

english: What is it you dont like about winter weather?
chinese: 你不喜欢冬天的天气什么？

english: I dont like it when the weather gets real cold.
chinese: 我不喜欢天气变得很冷的时候。

english: I cant stand summer weather.
chinese: 我受不了夏天的天气。

english: The thing I dont like about driving is all the traffic on the road.
chinese: 我不喜欢开车的一点是路上的交通。

english: He doesnt like the idea of going to bed early.
chinese: 他不喜欢早睡的想法。

english: I like to play tennis, but Im not a very good player.
chinese: 我喜欢打网球，但我打得不太好。

english: I dont like spinach even though I know its good for me.
chinese: 我不喜欢菠菜，尽管我知道它对我有好处。

english: Im afraid youre being too particular about your food.
chinese: 恐怕你对食物太挑剔了。

english: He always finds fault with everything.
chinese: 他总是对一切挑毛病。

english: She doesnt like anything I do or say.
chinese: 她不喜欢我做的或说的任何事。

english: You have wonderful taste in clothes.
chinese: 你在衣服上很有品味。

english: Whats your favorite pastime?
chinese: 你最喜欢的消遣是什么？

english: What did you like best about the movie?
chinese: 你最喜欢这部电影的什么？

english: I didnt like the taste of the medicine, but I took it anyway.
chinese: 我不喜欢药的味道，但我还是吃了。

english: Why do you dislike the medicine so much?
chinese: 你为什么这么不喜欢这药？

english: If you want my advice, I dont think you should go.
chinese: 要我说，你不该去。

english: I suggest that you tear up the letter and start over again.
chinese: 我建议你把信撕了重写。

english: Its only a suggestion, and you can do what you please.
chinese: 只是个建议，你随意。

english: Let me give you a little fatherly advice.
chinese: 让我给你点父亲般的建议。

english: If you dont like it , I wish you would say so.
chinese: 你要是不喜欢，希望你说出来。

english: Please dont take offense. I only wanted to tell you what I think.
chinese: 请别见怪，我只是想告诉你我的想法。

english: In my opinion, the house isnt worth the price theyre asking.
chinese: 我觉得这房子不值他们要的价。

english: My feeling is that you ought to stay home tonight.
chinese: 我觉得你今晚该待在家。

english: Its none of my business, but I think you ought to work harder.
chinese: 不关我事，但我觉得你该更努力。

english: In general, my reaction is favorable.
chinese: 总的来说，我反应是赞同的。

english: If you dont take my advice, youll be sorry.
chinese: 不听我劝，你会后悔的。

english: Ive always tried not to interfere in your affairs.
chinese: 我一直尽量不干涉你的事。

english: Im old enough to make up my own mind.
chinese: 我够大了，能自己做主。

english: Thanks for the advice, but this is something I have to figure out myself.
chinese: 谢谢建议，但这事我得自己想清楚。

english: He wont pay attention to anybody. Youre just wasting your breath.
chinese: 他谁的话都不听，你白费口舌。

english: Would you please hold the door open for me?
chinese: 能帮我扶一下门吗？

english: Y oure very kind to take the trouble to help me.
chinese: 你真好，费心帮我。

english: I wish I could repay you somehow for your kindness.
chinese: 希望我能报答你的好意。

english: Im afraid it was a bother for you to do this.
chinese: 恐怕这事麻烦你了。

english: It wasnt any bother. I was glad to do it.
chinese: 不麻烦，我很乐意。

english: Theres just one last favor I need to ask of you.
chinese: 我只需请你帮最后一个忙。

english: Id be happy to help you in any way I can.
chinese: 我愿意尽力帮你。

english: Would you mind giving me a push? My car has stalled. 8
chinese: 你能推我一下吗？我的车熄火了。

english: Would you be so kind as to open this window for me? Its stuck.
chinese: 你能帮我打开这扇窗吗？它卡住了。

english: If theres anything else I can do, please let me know.
chinese: 如果还有我能做的事，请告诉我。

english: This is the last time Ill ever ask you to do anything for me.
chinese: 这是我最后一次请你为我做事。

english: I certainly didnt intend to cause you so much inconvenience.
chinese: 我绝不是有意给你添这么多麻烦。

english: Hell always be indebted to you for what youve done.
chinese: 他会永远感激你所做的一切。

english: Could you lend me ten dollars? I left my wallet at home.
chinese: 你能借我十美元吗？我把钱包忘在家里了。

english: Id appreciate it if you would turn out the lights. Im sleepy.
chinese: 如果你能关灯我会很感激。我困了。

english: I didnt realize the time had passed so quickly.
chinese: 我没意识到时间过得这么快。

english: Ive got a lot of things to do before I can leave.
chinese: 我走之前还有很多事要做。

english: For one thing, Ive got to drop by the bank to get some money.
chinese: 首先，我得去银行取点钱。

english: Itll take almost all my savings to buy the ticket.
chinese: 买这张票几乎要花光我所有的积蓄。

english: Oh , I just remembered something! I have to apply for a passport.
chinese: 哦，我刚想起一件事！我得申请护照。

english: I almost forgot to have the phone disconnected.
chinese: 我差点忘了把电话停机。

english: Its a good thing you reminded me to take my heavy coat.
chinese: 幸好你提醒我带上厚外套。

english: I never would have thought of it if you hadnt mentioned it.
chinese: 要不是你提起，我根本想不到。

english: Ill see you off at the airport.
chinese: 我会去机场送你。

english: Theyre calling your flight now. You barely have time to make it.
chinese: 他们正在呼叫你的航班。你几乎没时间赶上了。

english: Youd better run or youre going to be left behind.
chinese: 你最好跑起来，否则就要落后了。

english: Dont forget to cable to let us know you arrived safely.
chinese: 别忘了发电报通知我们你已安全到达。

english: Im sure Ive forgotten something, but its too late now.
chinese: 我肯定忘了什么东西，但现在太晚了。

english: Do you have anything to declare for customs?
chinese: 你有什么需要向海关申报的吗？

english: You dont have to pay any duty on personal belongings. [1] Countries and nationalities
chinese: 个人物品无需缴税。[1] 国家和国籍

english: Whats your nationality? Are you American?
chinese: 你是什么国籍？你是美国人吗？

english: What part of the world do you come from?
chinese: 你来自世界哪个地区？

english: Im an American by birth.
chinese: 我生来就是美国人。

english: I was born in Spain, but Im a citizen of France.
chinese: 我出生在西班牙，但我是法国公民。

english: Do you know what the population of Japan is?
chinese: 你知道日本的人口是多少吗？

english: Whats the area of the Congo in square miles?
chinese: 刚果的面积是多少平方英里？

english: Who is the governor of this state?
chinese: 这个州的州长是谁？

english: According to the latest census, our population has increased.
chinese: 根据最新人口普查，我们的人口增长了。

english: Politically, the country is divided into fifty states.
chinese: 政治上，这个国家分为五十个州。

english: The industrial area is centered largely in the north.
chinese: 工业区主要集中在北部。

english: The country is rich in natural resources. It has mineral deposits.
chinese: 这个国家自然资源丰富，有矿产资源。

english: This nation is noted for its economic stability.
chinese: 这个国家以经济稳定著称。

english: How old do you have to be to vote in the national elections?
chinese: 参加全国选举必须年满多少岁？

english: Today we celebrate our day of independence. Its a national holiday.
chinese: 今天我们庆祝独立日，这是全国性假日。

english: My home is in the capital. Its a cosmopolitan city.
chinese: 我家在首都，那是个国际化大都市。

english: Geographically , this country is located in the southern hemisphere.
chinese: 这个国家位于南半球。

english: Its a beautiful country with many large lakes.
chinese: 这是一个美丽的国家，有许多大湖。

english: This part of the country is very mountainous.
chinese: 这个国家的这一部分多山。

english: The land in this region is dry and parched.
chinese: 这个地区的土地干燥焦枯。

english: Along the northern coast there are many high cliffs.
chinese: 北部海岸有许多高崖。

english: There are forests here, and lumbering is important.
chinese: 这里有森林，伐木业很重要。

english: The scenery is beautiful near the Pacific Ocean.
chinese: 太平洋附近风景优美。

english: This mountain range has many high peaks and deep canyons.
chinese: 这条山脉有许多高峰和深谷。

english: what kind of climate do you have? Is it mild?
chinese: 你们那里气候怎么样？温和吗？

english: How far is it from the shore of the Atlantic to the mountains?
chinese: 从大西洋岸边到山区有多远？

english: Is the coastal plain good for farming?
chinese: 沿海平原适合耕种吗？

english: Whats the longest river in the United States?
chinese: 美国最长的河流是哪条？

english: Are most of the lakes located in the north central region?
chinese: 大多数湖泊都位于中北部地区吗？

english: As you travel westward, does the land get higher?
chinese: 向西走，地势会变高吗？

english: The weather is warm and sunny here. Do you get much rain?
chinese: 这里天气温暖晴朗。你们那里雨水多吗？

english: Children enter school at the age of five, dont they?
chinese: 孩子五岁上学，对吗？

english: In elementary school, the child learns to read and write.
chinese: 在小学，孩子学习读写。

english: In secondary school, children get more advanced knowledge.
chinese: 在中学，孩子获得更高级的知识。

english: In universities, students train to become teachers and engineers.
chinese: 在大学，学生接受成为教师和工程师的培训。

english: He went to grade school in New York and high school in Chicago.
chinese: 他在纽约上小学，在芝加哥上中学。

english: In college I majored in science. What was your major?
chinese: 大学时我主修科学。你主修什么？

english: My sister graduated from high school. Graduation was last night.
chinese: 我妹妹高中毕业了。毕业典礼在昨晚。

english: Im a graduate of Yale University. I have a Bachelor of Arts degree.
chinese: 我毕业于耶鲁大学。我有文学学士学位。

english: If you expect to enter the university, you should apply now.
chinese: 如果你想上大学，现在就应该申请。

english: This is my first year of college. Im a freshman.
chinese: 这是我大学第一年。我是新生。

english: My uncle is a high school principal.
chinese: 我叔叔是高中校长。

english: What kind of grades did you make in college?
chinese: 你大学成绩怎么样？

english: During your first year of college, did you make straight As?
chinese: 大学第一年，你成绩全是A吗？

english: My brother is a member of the faculty. He teaches economics.
chinese: 我哥哥是教员。他教经济学。

english: John has extracurricular activities. Hes on the football team.
chinese: 约翰有课外活动。他在足球队。

english: Im a federal employee. I work for the Department of Labor.
chinese: 我是联邦雇员。我在劳工部工作。

english: What kind of work do you do? Are you a salesman?
chinese: 你做什么工作？你是销售员吗？

english: As soon as I complete my training, Im going to be a bank teller.
chinese: 培训一结束，我就去当银行出纳员。

english: John has built up his own business. He owns a hotel.
chinese: 约翰创立了自己的事业。他拥有一家酒店。

english: What do you want to be when you grow up?
chinese: 你长大后想做什么？

english: I like painting, but I wouldnt want it to be my lifes work.
chinese: 我喜欢画画，但不想把它当作终身事业。

english: Have you ever thought about a career in the medical profession?
chinese: 你有没有想过从事医疗行业？

english: My uncle was a pilot with the airlines. He just retired.
chinese: 我叔叔曾是航空公司飞行员。他刚退休。

english: My brothers in the army. He was just promoted to the rank of major.
chinese: 我哥哥在军队。他刚晋升为少校。

english: I have a good-paying job with excellent hours.
chinese: 我有一份薪水不错、工作时间很好的工作。

english: My sister worked as a secretary before she got married.
chinese: 我姐姐结婚前是秘书。

english: Georges father is an attorney. He has his own practice.
chinese: 乔治的父亲是律师，自己开事务所。

english: He always takes pride in his work. Hes very efficient.
chinese: 他总是对工作很自豪，效率很高。

english: Mr. Smith is a politician. Hes running for election as governor.
chinese: 史密斯先生是政治家，正在竞选州长。

english: After a successful career in business , he was appointed ambassador.
chinese: 在商界取得成功后，他被任命为大使。

english: Because of the warm and sunny weather , oranges grow very well here.
chinese: 因为天气温暖晴朗，这里橙子长得很好。

english: In this flat country people grow wheat and corn and raise cattle.
chinese: 在这个平坦的国家，人们种小麦、玉米并养牛。

english: The ground around here is stony and not very good for farming.
chinese: 这周围的地面多石，不太适合耕种。

english: What are the principal farm products in this region?
chinese: 这个地区的主要农产品是什么？

english: Milk, butter, and cheese are shipped here from the dairy farms. 9
chinese: 牛奶、黄油和奶酪从奶牛场运到这里。

english: They had to cut down a lot of trees to make room for farms.
chinese: 他们不得不砍掉很多树来腾出农田。

english: At this time of the year farmers plow their fields.
chinese: 每年这个时候农民都在耕地。

english: On many farms youll find cows and chickens.
chinese: 在许多农场，你能看到牛和鸡。

english: If you have cows you have to get up early to do the milking.
chinese: 如果养牛，你就得早起挤奶。

english: Tractors have revolutionized farming.
chinese: 拖拉机彻底改变了农业。

english: In the United States, there are many factories for making cloth.
chinese: 在美国，有很多制造布料的工厂。

english: Factories employ both male and female workers.
chinese: 工厂同时雇用男工和女工。

english: If you work in a factory, you usually have to punch a clock.
chinese: 如果在工厂工作，通常得打卡。

english: Is meat packing a big industry in your country?
chinese: 肉类加工在你们国家是大产业吗？

english: Is it true that manufacturing of automobiles is a major industry?
chinese: 汽车制造是主要产业，这是真的吗？

english: My hobby is collecting stamps. Do you have a hobby?
chinese: 我的爱好是集邮。你有爱好吗？

english: Ive always thought photography would be an interesting hobby.
chinese: 我一直认为摄影会是个有趣的爱好。

english: Some people like horseback riding , but I prefer golfing as a hobby.
chinese: 有些人喜欢骑马，但我更喜欢把打高尔夫球作为爱好。

english: Do you have any special interests other than your job?
chinese: 除了工作，你还有什么特别的兴趣吗？

english: Learning foreign languages is just an avocation with me.
chinese: 学外语只是我的业余爱好。

english: I find stamp collecting relaxing and it takes my mind off my work.
chinese: 我觉得集邮让人放松，能让我从工作中分心。

english: On weekends I like to get my mind off my work by reading good books.
chinese: 周末我喜欢读好书来从工作中分心。

english: My cou sin is a member of a drama club. He seems to enjoy acting.
chinese: 我表弟是戏剧社的成员。他似乎很喜欢表演。

english: He plays the piano for his own enjoyment.
chinese: 他弹钢琴是为了自娱自乐。

english: Ive gotten interested in hi-fi. Im building my own equipment.
chinese: 我对高保真音响产生了兴趣。我正在自己组装设备。

english: Hes not a professional. He plays the piano for the fun of it.
chinese: 他不是专业的。他弹钢琴是为了好玩。

english: Ive heard of unusual hobbies, but Ive never heard of that one.
chinese: 我听说过不寻常的爱好，但从没听说过那个。

english: The trouble with photography is that its an expensive hobby.
chinese: 摄影的麻烦在于它是个昂贵的爱好。

english: That s rare set of coins. How long did it take you to collect them?
chinese: 那是一套罕见的硬币。你花了多长时间收集的？

english: I started a new hobby. I got tired of working in the garden.
chinese: 我开始了一个新爱好。我厌倦了在花园里干活。

english: Baseball is my favorite sport. Whats your favorite?
chinese: 棒球是我最喜欢的运动。你最喜欢什么？

english: My nephew is a baseball player. He is a catcher.
chinese: 我侄子是个棒球运动员。他是接球手。

english: When you played football, what position did you play?
chinese: 你踢足球时，踢什么位置？

english: We played a game last night. The score was tired six-to-six.
chinese: 我们昨晚打了一场比赛。比分是六比六平。

english: I went to a boxing match last night. It was a good fight.
chinese: 我昨晚去看了一场拳击比赛。那是一场精彩的比赛。

english: When I was on the track team, I used to run the quarter mile.
chinese: 我参加田径队时，常跑四分之一英里。

english: I like fishing and hunting, but I dont like swimming.
chinese: 我喜欢钓鱼和打猎，但不喜欢游泳。

english: My favorite winter sport is skiing. I belong to a ski club.
chinese: 我最喜欢的冬季运动是滑雪。我参加了一个滑雪俱乐部。

english: Would you be interested in going to the horse races this afternoon?
chinese: 你今天下午有兴趣去看赛马吗？

english: The hardest thing to learn is to be a good loser.
chinese: 最难学的是输得起。

english: Be a good sport. Play according to the rules of the game.
chinese: 做个有风度的人。按比赛规则来。

english: Our family went camping last summer. We had to buy a new tent.
chinese: 我们家去年夏天去露营，得买一个新帐篷。

english: This afte rnoon we went to the gym for a workout. We lifted weights.
chinese: 今天下午我们去健身房锻炼，举了重。

english: What do you do for recreation? Do you have a hobby?
chinese: 你休闲时做什么？有什么爱好吗？

english: My muscles are sore from playing baseball.
chinese: 我打棒球打得肌肉酸痛。

english: I sent in a subscription to that magazine. Its put out every week.
chinese: 我订阅了那本杂志，它每周出版一期。

english: If you subscribe to the newspaper , itll be delivered to your door.
chinese: 如果你订阅报纸，它会送到你家门口。

english: I didn t read the whole paper. I just glanced at the headlines.
chinese: 我没读完整份报纸，只扫了一眼标题。

english: The first chapter of the story is in this issue of the magazine.
chinese: 这个故事的第一章在这期杂志上。

english: I havent seen the latest issue of the magazine. Is it out yet?
chinese: 我还没看到最新一期杂志，出版了吗？

english: Whats the total circulation of this newspaper?
chinese: 这份报纸的总发行量是多少？

english: Im looking for the classified section. Have you seen it?
chinese: 我在找分类广告版，你看到了吗？

english: My brother-in-law is a reporter on The New York Times staff.
chinese: 我姐夫是《纽约时报》的记者。

english: There was an article in todays paper about the election.
chinese: 今天报纸上有一篇关于选举的文章。

english: There wasnt much news in the paper today.
chinese: 今天报纸上没什么新闻。

english: How long have you been taking this magazine?
chinese: 你订阅这份杂志多久了？

english: Did you read the article about the rescue of the two fishermen?
chinese: 你读了那篇关于营救两名渔民的文章吗？

english: Why don t you put an advertisement in the paper to sell your car?
chinese: 你为什么不在报纸上登广告卖车？

english: I got four replies to my ad about the bicycle for sale.
chinese: 我的自行车出售广告收到了四个回复。

english: My son has a newspaper route. He delivers the morning paper.
chinese: 我儿子负责送报路线，他送晨报。

english: What channel did you watch on television last night?
chinese: 你昨晚看电视是哪个频道？

english: I don t get a good picture on my TV set. Theres something wrong.
chinese: 我的电视画面不好，出了问题。

english: You get good reception on your radio.
chinese: 你的收音机接收效果很好。

english: Please turn the radio up. Its too low.
chinese: 请把收音机调大，声音太小了。

english: Whats on following the news and weather? Do you have a TV guide?
chinese: 新闻和天气之后是什么节目？你有电视指南吗？

english: You ought to have Bill look at your TV. Maybe he could fix it.
chinese: 你应该让比尔看看你的电视，也许他能修。

english: We met one of the engineers over at the television station.
chinese: 我们在电视台遇到了一位工程师。

english: Where can I plug in the TV? Is this outlet all right?
chinese: 我在哪里插电视？这个插座可以吗？

english: I couldnt hear the program because there was too much static.
chinese: 我听不清节目，因为静电干扰太大。

english: Your car radio works very well. What kind is it?
chinese: 你的车载收音机效果很好，是什么牌子的？

english: The next time I buy a TV set , Im going to buy a portable model.
chinese: 下次买电视，我要买个便携式的。

english: I wonder if this is a local broadcast.
chinese: 我想知道这是不是本地广播。

english: Youd get better TV reception if you had an outside antenna.
chinese: 如果你有室外天线，电视接收效果会更好。

english: Most amateur radio operators build their own equipment.
chinese: 大多数业余无线电操作员自己组装设备。

english: Station WRC is off the air now. They signed off two hours ago.
chinese: WRC电台现在停播了，他们两小时前就结束了广播。

english: Whats your favorite kind of music? Do you like jazz?
chinese: 你最喜欢哪种音乐？喜欢爵士乐吗？

english: Hes a composer of serious music. I like his music a lot.
chinese: 他是一位严肃音乐作曲家。我非常喜欢他的音乐。

english: We went to a concert last night to hear the symphony orchestra.
chinese: 我们昨晚去听了交响乐团的音乐会。

english: My brother took lessons on the trumpet for nearly ten years.
chinese: 我哥哥学了将近十年的小号。

english: You play the piano beautifully. How much do you practice every day?
chinese: 你钢琴弹得很美。你每天练多久？

english: Ive never heard that piece before. Who wrote it?
chinese: 我从没听过那首曲子。是谁写的？

english: Have you ever thought about becoming a professional musician?
chinese: 你有没有想过成为职业音乐家？

english: Who is the author of this novel?
chinese: 这本小说的作者是谁？

english: Ive never read a more stirring story.
chinese: 我从没读过比这更激动人心的故事。

english: Who would you name as the greatest poet of our time?
chinese: 你认为谁是我们这个时代最伟大的诗人？

english: This poetry is realistic. l dont care for it very much.
chinese: 这首诗很写实。我不太喜欢。

english: Many great writers were not appreciated fully while they were alive.
chinese: 许多伟大作家在世时未得到充分赏识。

english: This is a poem about frontier life in the United States.
chinese: 这是一首关于美国边疆生活的诗。

english: This writer uses vivid descriptions in his writings.
chinese: 这位作家在作品中运用了生动的描写。

english: How much do you know about the works of Henry Wadsworth Longfellow?
chinese: 你对亨利·沃兹沃斯·朗费罗的作品了解多少？
